headline: Indian stock markets rally on strong foreign fund inflows, IT buying, and gains in banking and realty stocks.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows provided strong momentum to Indian equity markets.
Buying interest in IT and realty sectors contributed to consecutive daily market gains.
HDFC Bank led benchmark gains during recent market rallies.
Strengthening of the Indian Rupee supported positive investor sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex gained 390 points with Nifty trading near 25,900 driven by gains in IT and realty stocks.
Patanjali Foods, Torrent Power, Asian Paints, KPI Green, and Ashiana Housing are among key stocks to watch today.
Foreign fund inflows and IT share buying triggered a multi-day stock market rally.
Rupee gained significantly in recent sessions, reaching an eight-month high.
summary: Indian stock benchmark indices continued their rally on foreign institutional buying and strong IT and banking support. HDFC Bank, Reliance, and Tata Steel featured among key sector gainers during recent rallies. Patanjali Foods, Torrent Power, and Asian Paints are highlighted among top stocks to watch today.
